def min_Operations(A, B):
    """Write a python function to find the minimum operations required to make two numbers equal.

    In one operation, a number can be multiplied by 2 or, when it is
    even, divided by 2. Two numbers can therefore be made equal only
    when they have the same odd part after removing all factors of 2;
    the minimum number of operations is then the difference between
    their exponents of 2. Return -1 when making them equal is
    impossible.
    """
    if A == B:
        return 0
    if A == 0 or B == 0:
        return -1

    a = A
    exponent_a = 0
    while a % 2 == 0:
        a //= 2
        exponent_a += 1

    b = B
    exponent_b = 0
    while b % 2 == 0:
        b //= 2
        exponent_b += 1

    if a != b:
        return -1
    return abs(exponent_a - exponent_b)
